verdict.rationale: The docs describe Perplexity's Search API as delivering "real-time" web search results with "advanced filtering", which supports the freshness side of the story. The only filter named is domain filtering, an adjacent control that earns no credit here, and no date-range or recency filter is documented. missing for 10: explicitly documented date-range filters, recency filter parameters, evidence on index update frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration of freshness.
